claims.statement: EU waste law defines conditions under which a production residue can be a by-product, including certain further use, direct usability, integral production, and lawful use.
EU feed-hygiene rules require registration or approval, safety controls, records, and traceability even for relevant traders.

contrary_evidence: A residue is not automatically a by-product, and use as feed can create registration, testing, contamination, and documentation obligations that erase margins.

economics.acquisition_route: Food-industry associations, lab referrals, and targeted email offers based on predictable production categories
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Contract 2000 tonnes per month by year 3 (unvalidated), expand into higher-value standardized fractions by year 6 (unvalidated), and support founder equity above PLN 5 million by year 8 (unvalidated)
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours per week during validation (unvalidated), with hauliers and labs contracted
economics.gross_margin_basis: Direct producer-to-buyer hauling and outsourced testing support 25-45% gross margin (unvalidated)
economics.payback: Supplier acquisition payback within 3-7 recurring loads (unvalidated)
economics.pricing: PLN 40-180 spread per tonne (unvalidated) plus PLN 500-1500 supplier compliance fee per month (unvalidated)
economics.retention_or_repeat: Two-year offtake agreements (unvalidated) and weekly or monthly loads

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Contracted volume, batch history, route density, and buyer acceptance specifications reduce transaction risk
fingerprint.customer: Small food processors generating side streams and registered feed, ingredient, material, or energy buyers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Supplier category lists, laboratories, and repeat industrial offtake referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Exclusive supply rights, sampling, classification evidence, buyer matching, and direct logistics
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Buyer pays on accepted delivery; supplier may pay for documented diversion and compliant coordination
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A recurring side stream incurs disposal cost or a buyer suffers unreliable raw-material supply

founder_fit: Optimization, forecasting, and matching are data-heavy.
Recurring plant contracts concentrate social effort.
Capital-light brokerage can precede any owned processing.
risks: The stated PLN 130000 startup capital requirement is unvalidated.

structure.commercial_archetype: Exclusive industrial offtake aggregation and traceable physical-commodity brokerage
structure.control_point: Multi-year first-call rights over consistent side-stream volumes with batch specifications and lawful-use documentation
structure.critical_dependency: Each stream must qualify for its intended lawful status and meet contamination, traceability, storage, and buyer specifications

thesis: Secure exclusive, specification-bound offtake rights to recurring brewery, juice, milling, and food-plant side streams, sample and classify each stream before sale, and match lawful lots to registered feed, ingredient, material, or biogas buyers. Start as a broker without storage; the moat is contracted tonnage, traceability, and repeat quality data rather than a generic marketplace.
title: SideStream Offtake Rights Network
uncertainties: Which Polish side streams combine high frequency, low contamination, and short haul distance?
Can suppliers grant exclusivity without volume guarantees?
